title: Every smart telescope we've reviewed and highly rate that is cheaper for Black Friday — full list
summary: Black Friday has seen the price of smart telescopes slashed, with great beginner models available from Unistellar, ZWO, Vaonis and Dwarflab.
contentText:
Smart telescopes automatically go to, focus on and photograph your favorite night sky targets with only a few minutes of setup and the push of a button. We've been reviewing them for years and there are only a handful we now recommend as the very best smart telescopes you should buy.

But they vary in price massively, from a few hundred to a few thousand dollars. That's why I have rounded up three models that are already under $700 before these Black Friday deals . A couple of the more premium options are included too because they have big savings if that is something you are interested in. Check out our smart telescopes guide for the lowdown on the best models you can get right now.

If you aren't sure about whether you want to buy one, why not join Space+, our membership community and enter our prize draw to win the highly portable Dwarf Mini smart telescope?

Save $25 on the ZWO Seestar S30 Plus . We recommend it to beginners for its excellent deep-sky imaging, low cost and built-in filters for specific target imaging like dual-band for nebulas and solar for observing the sun. View Deal

Save $35 on the ZWO Seestar S30 Pro . It performs well under light polluted skies and features an 8.3MP resolution sensor, which is great for imaging galaxies and nebulas. View Deal

Save over $500 on our best smart telescope for versatility, thanks to its small form factor and light weight compared to the rest of the Unistellar line-up. It has autofocus and doesn't require collimation, so it is the perfect smart telescope for a beginner.

It got four and a half stars in our Unistellar Odyssey review thanks to its great views of deep space objects and good color rendition on astrophotography shots. View Deal

Vespera Pro 2: was $2990 now $2490
Save on a premium motorized telescope. It features a 12.5MP sensor, upgraded optical design over Vaonis Vespera Pro and has a mosaic mode for stitching together wider potions of the night sky.

It also comes ready with a tall carbon fiber tripod for use right out of the box. View Deal
